notes: Remote performance numbers and unsupported correctness conclusions were withdrawn after the comparison audit.
The image versions describe installed packages, not a comparative feature or quality certification.
Retained wrapped-JSON subjects share one input, an exact output count and the same decoded application-message check.
Finite timing datasets use one warmup and ten measured repetitions on the same c5.large host with the same Vector binary and fixture.
Full-fixture delivery/equivalence checks were performed separately on macOS arm64 with Vector 0.61.0 and file output replacing blackhole.
Timings include process startup, input streaming, pipeline reduction, drain and shutdown; they are not isolated transform CPU costs.
The untransformed klog stdin reference and continuous-file rate observation are withheld as comparative results.
